title: BCA/16/2024 of JASWANT SINGH RAWAT Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Bail Cancellation Application No.16 of 2024
Jaswant Singh Rawat ........Applicant

Present:-
Mr. Priyanshu Gairola, Advocate for the applicant joined
through video conferencing.
Mr. M.A. Khan, AGA for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 Respondent no.2/accused was granted
anticipatory bail in Case Crime/FIR No.64 of 2023, under
Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B IPC, Police Station
Nehru Colony, District Dehradun, by this Court on
23.07.2024 in ABA No.260 of 2023. Now, the bail
cancellation application has been moved by the informant
of the case.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would
submit that summons have been issued to respondent
no.2 for appearance in the court, but summons could not
be served. He would submit that the next date was fixed
for 22.01.2024.
4. Whatever ground has been alleged and raised
for cancellation of anticipatory bail application may not be

2
the ground of cancelation of anticipatory bail application.
5. Having considered, this Court is of the view
that there is no reason to make any indulgence in the
application for cancellation of anticipatory bail
application. It deserves to be dismissed.
6. The bail cancellation application is dismissed.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J)
 25.11.2024
Ravi
